text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, Aug 5 - Bombay - No labour problems. Six vessels loading at berth, 19 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 7 waiting to discharge, 1 under repair, 2 awaiting orders. Expected berthing delays, containers 2-3 days, bulkers 10-12 days, general cargo 3-4 days. Calcutta - One vessel loading at berth, 18 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 bunkering. 26 Vessels due of which 3 coking coal, 11 products tankers, 8 containers, 1 crude oil, 1 thermal coal. Cochin - No labour problems. One vessel loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 1 general cargo vessel at CSL jetty, 1 tanker at repair dock, 1 vessel awaiting orders. 13 Vessels due with up to 1 day delay expected.

Chennai (Madras) - Five vessels loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth. 12 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge. 37 Vessels due (8 coal, 2 fertiliser, 5 general cargo, 4 iron ore, 2 palm oil, 8 containers, 3 fertiliser, 1 logs, 1 passenger vessel. 3 Other vessels with the following delays expected, fertiliser/scrap 5-6 days, coal/coke/iron ore/others 2-3 days, no delays for containers. Mormugao - No labour problems. One vessel discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 bunkering, 1 at dry-dock, 1 awaiting orders. 4 Vessels due (1 phosphoric acid, 1 machinery, 1 hsd, 1 caustic soda) with no delays expected. Kandla - Three vessels loading at berth, 8 loading in stream, 6 discharging at berth, 1 discharging in stream, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 20 waiting to discharge. 14 Vessels due with 15-16 days berthing delay expected.

Mangalore - No labour problems. Four vessels loading/discharging at berth, 1 under repair. 12 Vessels due with 2-3 days berthing delay expected. Jawaharlal Nehru - No labour problems. Bulk berth No.4 not available until September 30. Two fertiliser/raw materials/food grain vessels discharging at berth, 1 iron ore discharging at anchorage, 2 fertiliser/raw materials/food grain waiting at anchorage to discharge, 4 tankers/iron ore due with 1-2 days berthing delay expected. Berthing delays for urea vessels 20-28 days, other fertiliser vessels 25-30 days. Paradip - No labour problems. Five vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discrge, 8 due with 10 days delay expected.

Tuticorin - No labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 6 waiting to discharge. 3 Vessels due with 1-2 days delay expected at present. Visakhapatnam - No labour problems. Eight vessels loading at berth, 9 discharging at berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berths, 7 waiting to load at inner harbour berths. 20 Vessels due with 7-8 days delay expected.

MALAYSIA, Aug 6 - Port Keelang - North/south port - Container/ro-ro berth - 6 Vessels berthed, 6 waiting with 1 day waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels berthed, 2 berthing 6/8, 3 waiting with 2 days waiting time. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels berthed, 4 waiting with 3 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Vessels berthed, 7 waiting with 1 day waiting time. West port - Container/ro-ro berth - 2 Vessels berthed, none waiting, no delays. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels berthed, 4 waiting with 3 days waiting time. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 1 Vessels berthed, none waiting, 1 day waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 1 Vessel berthed, none waiting, no delays.
MAURITIUS, Aug 5 - Port Louis - No labour problems. One container vessel berthed discharging/loading, no idle vessels. Fishing port - 6 Vessels berthed, 13 due by 11/8.

PAKISTAN, Aug 4 - Karachi - Five vessels loading at berth (naphtha, rice, cotton, general cargo). 4 Loading/discharging containers at berth. 6 Discharging at berth (fuel oil, fish, sugar, general cargo, sulphur). 4 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (jute, general cargo, containers, fish, sugar). 3 Vessels awaiting orders, 6 due with up to 1 day delay expected for general cargo/container vessels. Port Qasim - July 31 - Five vessels discharging at berth (palm oil, wheat, fuel oil). 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load crude oil, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge (wheat, sugar).

SINGAPORE, Aug 4 - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 12 Container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 15 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 9 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal - 1 General cargo vessel berthed. Jurong port - 1 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessel berthed. Oil terminals/sbm buoys - 23 Tankers berthed. Minimal berthing delays at all terminals/ports/buoys. Later morning and early afternoon showers being experienced.

SRI LANKA, Aug 5 - Colombo - Labour shortage continues. Berthing/unberthing delays being experienced on break bulk and conventional vessels. 15 Vessels loading at berth (11 containers, 1 general cargo, 3 essential services). 19 Discharging at berth (1 bagged sugar, 10 containers, 4 bagged urea, 1 essential services, 3 general cargo). 7 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (6 container/feeders, 1 onions/general cargo), 1 vessel under repair, 9 under arrest, 4 awaiting orders, 2 changing crews. Vessels due with the following delays, general cargo 2-3 days, containers/feeders 24 hours. Galle - No vessels loading or discharging. Trincomalee - One vessel discharging at berth, 2 loading at berth.
